engine: Saisei's awards rail — small award badges with VERTICAL text (writing-mode), pinned to the RIGHT edge, stacked, sliding IN from the right (translateX) after the page settles. Harvested from D_saisei (S9).

measured_teardown.move: reveal() slides .var-badge from translateX(100%) to 0 + opacity 0->1, staggered; each badge is writing-mode:vertical-rl, docked to the right edge.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei: W. Winner / W. Site of the Day vertical tabs slide in from the right after the hero settles (~133ms, ease-out).

entry: VerticalAwardsRail.create(target, opts) -> { reveal(), set(p), hide(), destroy }. target = .var-rail with .var-badge items (writing-mode vertical). reveal() slides them in from the right, staggered.
law: transform(translateX) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> shown. The hidden state is set THROUGH gsap.set when present (so gsap.to({xPercent:0}) lands exactly). owns_pin false.
gate_mode: triggered (not scroll) — wheel gate doesn't apply. Verify the badges slide in from the right, smoothly.
proven: lab: OUR W. Winner / W. Site of the Day vertical badges slide in from the right edge to translateX(0) (landed, opacity 1). gsap.set-channel fix (no stray inline translateX residue). Probe (4x throttle): 0% long frames, 59.9fps, 0 warnings.
